steps: Peel and pit Peach, then cut into rough chunks and place in a medium bowl.
Halve and pit Avocado, scoop the flesh into the same bowl.
Add Lemon juice and smash everything together with a fork until chunky but spreadable.
Stir in Chia seeds and Vanilla extract until evenly distributed.
Spoon Plain yogurt into the base of each of 4 small cups, about 15 ml per cup.
Top each cup with an equal portion of the peach-avocado smash.
Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes so the Chia seeds thicken the mixture slightly before serving.
Serve chilled. Store covered in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours; do not freeze.
